document.about: MAHLE aftermarket catalogue AP-90-12. Its interchange lists wrap each competitor number and its MAHLE Clevite number into side-by-side copies of the same columns, two or three to a record, across the page.

notes: 2026-11-23: every cell's doc:rowHeader was the row's first cell, the first copy's key, so a MAHLE number in a later copy was paired with a competitor number it has nothing to do with (#52).

checks.issue: J17829, in the fourth pair, carried the first pair's FP-1804353 as its row header; it is the MAHLE Clevite number for Fel-Pro 55350.
In a list wrapped three columns to a record, the second copy's competitor (IHC, for 1811191-C3) was keyed by the first copy's number, 14079426.
